Complete Newborn Care Made Simple

Make newborn care simple and thoughtful with the BubCloud Leakproof Newborn Baby Gift Box Set. This complete, safe, and practical set includes all essential items for easy feeding, hygiene, and comfort, making it the perfect gift for new parents.

products.title: LeoLok 12Pcs Gift Boxes – Baby Shower Supplies
products.body_html:
LeoLok 12Pcs Gift Boxes – Baby Shower Supplies bring elegance and charm to every celebration. Thoughtfully designed for baby showers, birthdays, and gender reveals, these adorable candy boxes combine practicality and style, making them the perfect choice for party favors or decorative table accents.

Smart Design Features

• Set of 12 premium-quality gift boxes with matching bows and stickers
• Designed in soft pastel tones for boys, girls, or neutral themes
• Durable construction ensures boxes hold candies, trinkets, or small gifts securely
• Pre-folded for easy assembly and quick setup
• Lightweight and reusable for multiple events
• Complements any baby shower or birthday party décor

Setup and Usage

1. Assemble each box by folding along pre-scored lines

2. Fill with candies, chocolates, or small keepsakes

3. Seal with the included decorative bow and sticker

4. Arrange boxes on tables or distribute as party favors

5. Store unused boxes flat for future use

Product Specifications

Material: High-quality cardboard and satin ribbon
Dimensions: Standard mini gift box size
Colors: Pink, Blue, and Neutral pastel options
Suitable for: Baby showers, birthdays, weddings, and gender reveal events
Package: 12 assembled gift boxes with matching bows and stickers

Why Choose This Set

• Stylish and functional design adds a personal touch to any event
• Sturdy, eco-friendly materials ensure durability and reusability
• Quick and easy assembly saves time for busy hosts
• Versatile design fits a wide range of party themes
• Perfect balance of practicality and decorative appeal for memorable celebrations
